title: Querying Data with SELECT
description: Fundamentals of retrieving data — SELECT statements, WHERE filtering, logical operators, sorting, and limiting results.
longDescription: This module covers the fundamentals of querying data in SQL Server. You'll learn how to write SELECT statements, filter rows with WHERE, use logical operators, sort results with ORDER BY, and limit rows with TOP and OFFSET FETCH.
whatYouLearn: Write basic SELECT queries to retrieve data from tables
Filter rows using WHERE clause and logical operators (AND, OR, BETWEEN, IN, LIKE)
Sort query results using ORDER BY
Limit result sets using SELECT TOP and OFFSET FETCH
Handle NULL values and understand three-valued logic
Use DISTINCT to return unique values
